name: Tajima Kento
source:
One of [url=/c77885]Kanata’s[/url] friends.
He’s a hardcore gadgets-and-gizmos nerd whose father is an IT journalist.
He’s proud of the scores of tech tools he has that have all been heavily customized to his own tastes, but they all have too many functions for him to be able to make use of them when he really needs to.
